diagnostic.help: wire the place to a port of the refining net
diagnostic.message: refine shop.[deliver] by courier: [deliver] gives receipt to (delivered), but (delivered) is not wired from an output port of courier

source.text:
composition refined_order_unwired

use "order_flow.petrinet" as shop
use "courier.petrinet" as courier
wire shop.(sending) -> courier.(pickup)
refine shop.[deliver] by courier
